name: agent-writing-studio
description: A Vietnamese writing studio an AI agent runs from blank page to delivery: context interview, co-writing with self-declared machine spans, per-criterion critique against a genre rubric, voice-preserving edit, and forensic review. Genres are data files; nine profiles included. Skills and shared data run from this repository; case files stay in the ignored workspace/ folder or an external WRITING_STUDIO_DATA station.

interface.shortDescription: Vietnamese writing from brief to provenance-audited delivery
